description: This file contains implementation of floating-point parsing functions for the Abseil library, specifically parsing significant digits and handling special values like NaN and infinity in different numeric bases.

methods.name: AllowExponent
methods.description: Checks if the given character flags allow parsing an exponent.

methods.name: RequireExponent
methods.description: Checks if the given character flags require an exponent.

methods.name: ParseFloat
methods.description: Parses a floating-point number from a character range, handling special values, mantissa, exponent, and rounding.
